bio: Anna Kaufmann and Manuel Pristovnik have established a lovely, cosy restaurant with a modern-regional aesthetic. The friendly proprietress cultivates a laid-back atmosphere while the chef crafts contemporary and pleasingly pared-back dishes that are precisely executed and visually appealing. Dishes such as golden trout fillet with schupfnudeln (finger-shaped potato dumplings), peas, lemon and almonds, or milk-fed veal cordon bleu with rosemary ham, Alpine cheese, horseradish and lingonberries showcase the flavours of Styria – which are also reflected in the wine list. Tip: For overnight stays, there are individually designed boutique guestrooms....
